about: THE WIRE's Jobs (docs/19 §4): picked at a payphone, taken at Lucky's, made against the fuse. shots: the table's shot ids and how many of each; district: the Empire Wheel insert (0 Alley .. 7 City Hall); minutes: pay, in minutes of the empire's idle rate (floored by rank); fuse: seconds.
